question: A can do a piece of work in 24 days and B can do the same work in 30 days. If they work on it together for 8 days, then the fraction of the work that is left is:
solution:
Given:

A can do a piece of work in 24 days and B can do the same work in 30 days. 

They work on it together for 8 days

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let total work is 120 units ( Lcm of 24 and30 )

The efficiency of R is

⇒ 120 / 24 = 5 unit

Again, the Efficiency of S is,

⇒ 120 / 30 = 4 unit

Total Efficiency,

⇒ 5 + 4 = 9 unit

Total work done in 8 days,

⇒ 9 × 8 = 72 units

Total done 72 / 120 = 3/5 part

Part left (1 - 3/5) = 2/5 part 

∴ The correct option is 2
